records.performance_summary: HeartAssist standalone testing (pages 10-12): 'A deep learning based view recognition algorithm was validated using 888 fetal heart and adult heart images collected at five hospitals.' View recognition accuracy: fetal 93.21% (threshold 89%), adult 98.31% (threshold 84%). Segmentation dice: fetal 0.88 (threshold 0.8), adult 0.93 (threshold 0.9). Size measurement: fetal error rates 8% or less (area), 4% or less (angle), 11% or less (circumference, diameter); adult B-mode, M-mode and Doppler-mode auto measurements 'Pass if the PCC value is 0.8 or greater than the specification', with PCC computed against cardiologist measurements as ground truth. Dataset: male and female, Americans and Koreans, 7 fetal heart views and 16 adult heart views per ASE/AIUM guidelines, acquired on W10, W9 and V8 systems (only V8 images used for performance test). Adult ground truth traced by two cardiologists and two sonographers with at least 10 years of experience. Training/tuning/validation data independent. No clinical study required.

notes: Group samsung-a triage based solely on the local FDA 510(k) summary text files; no web search was needed because every AI feature is named in the summaries. Cardiac-relevant chain: HeartAssist was introduced in K211824 (HERA W10, Sep 2021) as a deep-learning FETAL heart view classifier with auto caliper placement; carried unchanged through K220043 and K230084 (HERA W9/W10 OB-focused clearances whose modifications were BiometryAssist/ViewAssist expansions); and expanded to ADULT echocardiography in K223387 (V8/V7, Feb 2023), which is the only Samsung K in this group with quantitative adult cardiac AI performance (adult view recognition 98.31% across 16 ASE/AIUM views, adult segmentation dice 0.93, B-mode/M-mode/Doppler auto-measurement PCC >= 0.8 vs cardiologist ground truth; 888 fetal+adult images from five hospitals). Caveat for the registry: K211824, K220043 and K230084 are marked is_cardiac_ultrasound_ai=true only because HeartAssist (fetal echocardiography) is present; if the registry scope is adult echo only, downgrade those three and keep K223387 as the defining clearance. Noted that ViewAssist is also validated on fetal heart views (K223387, K230084) but is a general OB view-recognition/annotation tool and was marked cardiac=false. K231772 is the newest V8/H8 platform clearance; its summary discusses only NerveTrack segmentation, so it is excluded despite likely carrying HeartAssist from predicate K223387. K210426's summary never uses the word AI for NerveTrack; the AI characterization comes from the successor K211945. All decision dates and device names taken from openfda_records.json.
